reasoning: Andrew's Greek Commentary was Englished by Constantinou (CUA 2011) — the underlying work. The Armenian recension attributed to 'Andrew AND Arethas' is a distinct composite text (Andrew's 7th-c. + Arethas's 10th-c. material combined in Armenian form). Nerses of Lambron's Armenian adaptation (Thomson 2007) is a 12th-c. reworking, not this text. No English translation of this specific Armenian recension found in any source searched.
